AND WHEREAS the Tenant has submitted a request to the Landlord for taking on lease the Premises in order to establish the Project (as hereinafter defined) and the Landlord has accepted such request and is willing to lease out the Premises to the Tenant.
NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises and the mutual covenants hereinafter contained, the Parties agree as follows:
In this Agreement, unless the context otherwise requires, the following words shall bear the meanings respectively set opposite them:
Effective Date: means the date set forth above;

Party or Parties: Party means the Landlord or Tenant (or their respective successors or assigns in interest under this Agreement) individually and Parties means both the Landlord and Tenant collectively.
Premises: The detail of which is laid out and depicted at Schedule 2
In this Agreement, unless otherwise specified:
the list of contents and headings are for ease of reference only and shall not be taken into account in construing this Agreement;
reference to an Article shall, unless a specific Sub-Article is referred to, be deemed to refer to the whole article;

from

(the "Initial Lease Term") and will be registered by Landlord at its cost with the relevant Municipality in Sultanate of Oman for .
Upon a written agreement of the Parties including the consideration to be paid by the Tenant, the lease term may be renewed for a further period of one (1) year beyond .

The Tenant shall carry out required partitions and fit out work, including interiors, to make it fit for its official use and purpose, such as work shall be carried out at its own expenses. In the event any such modification requires any permission, inspection of and/or compliance to any regulations including but not limited to those of Municipality and Civil Defense, then such formalities shall be completed by the Tenant at its own cost, and the Tenant shall provide to the Landlord a copy of such permits, approvals and/or compliance certificates, as the case may be, and to submit the copy of the layout drawings to Landlord for review and consent if any required.

Tenant shall be obliged to pay monthly rental of OMR per
usable area per month (the "Monthly Rent") during the Initial Lease Term the payment of the rent is stated under Schedule-1 of this Agreement. As on the date of this Agreement, Landlord has agreed to rent out
usable area with overall monthly rental of RO .
The Monthly Rent mentioned herein is excluding any taxes, taxes like Value Added Tax shall be extra provided that Landlord submit the invoice in compliance with applicable Oman tax laws.
The Landlord shall be responsible for the payment of the Municipality taxes for the Initial Lease Term.
The Tenant shall pay one (1) month rent as security deposit on signing of this agreement, along with Post-dated cheques for the whole term,

The Landlord state and affirms, that the Premises is free from any encumbrance of any kind and there shall not be any legal hindrance or otherwise as regard to the use of the Premises for the purpose of the Project.
The Tenant or its associate/group companies shall not sub-lease the leased premises to any external or third parties.

Routine housekeeping/cleaning activities such as – garbage disposal, cleaning of the frontal external area, corridors, elevators, toilets, pantries, staircases, and replacement to lighting fixtures in common areas shall be carried out by Landlord including utilities charges attributable to such common areas.

The Landlord to return /refund the security deposit at the end of this Agreement or at its termination whichever is earlier, after deducting any amounts for damages and/or painting incurred during reinstatement works or pending utilities, if applicable.
Tenant is to undertake any masonry/ MEP / False ceiling works modification within the leased Premises with prior consent from the Landlord.

Tenant shall be responsible to obtain and keep valid any permission, license, authority, approval, registration or consent of whatsoever nature required by it, for the implementation and execution of the Project within the Premises, from the Government of the Sultanate of Oman.
The Tenant shall also be liable and responsible for the following within the leased Premises:
Timely payment of utility bills post usage for the respective leased premises and meter numbers provided in Schedule 2.
Tenant will be liable to pay water charges and for any additional connection required for internal pantry and toilets billed through sub meters.
Tenant shall also ensure Insurance coverage of their business assets inside the Premises and other business activities;
Repair and maintenance of any damage caused by the Tenant to the Premises and/or the fittings therein;
Routine cleanliness such as – garbage disposal, cleaning rented premises, replacement to lighting fixtures installed by the Tenant.

Regular maintenance shall be carried out by the Landlord, at its cost, from time to time as required of the utility equipment(s) and assets of the Premises (like air conditioning /HVAC system, water pumps and regular plumbing).

The Tenant shall be obligated to surrender the Premises in the same condition as it received, at the (a) expiry of the Initial Lease Term or the subsequent renewal terms or (b) time of termination of this Agreement, Landlord reserves the right to inspect the Premises and arrange the necessary repair works at the cost of the Tenant.

A notice or other information required or authorized by this Agreement to be given by either Party to the other Party by hand or sent (by registered post, facsimiles transmission or comparable means of communication excluding electronic mail) to the other Party at the address referred to in Sub-Article 9.5.

Notice or other information given by post which is not returned to the sender as undelivered shall be deemed to have been given on the second working day after the envelope containing it was so posted; and the proof that the envelope containing any such notice or information was properly addressed and sent using registered post, and that it has not been so returned to the sender, shall be evidence that such notice or information has been duly given. A copy of such notice shall be sent vide electronic mail to the id as stated in Sub-Article 9.5.
A notice or other information sent by facsimile transmission or comparable means of communication (excluding electronic mail) shall be deemed to have been duly sent on the date of transmission.

Either Party may change its address (or facsimile number) for such notice from time to time by giving the other Party written notice of the same in the manner provided above. Each Party agrees to notify the other as promptly as reasonably possible of any damage to the other caused by its operations.

This Agreement contains the entire agreement between the Parties with respect to the subject matter of this Agreement, supersedes all previous agreement and understandings between the parties with respect to its subject matter, and may not be modified except by an instrument in writing signed by the duly authorized representative of each Party.

This Agreement is valid for an initial term of one (1) years and cannot be terminated by either Party without any valid reasons including but not limited to breach of terms and conditions of this Agreement.
The Landlord and the Tenant shall comply with all laws and regulations in force in the Sultanate of Oman.

This Agreement shall in all respects be construed in accordance with and governed by the laws of Oman. Any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement not amenable to an amicable settlement and remaining unsettled shall be referred to appropriate court/authority as per the laws of Oman and the Parties irrevocably submit to the jurisdiction of the said courts. The courts of Muscat will have exclusive jurisdiction to adjudicate any dispute arising under or in connection with this Agreement.

This Agreement has been executed in the English language, which shall be the binding and controlling language for all matters relating to the meaning and/or interpretation of this Agreement. The official text of this Agreement and any notices given hereunder shall be in English alone. In the event of any dispute concerning the construction or interpretation of this Agreement, reference shall be made only to this Agreement as written in English and not to any translation into any other language. All documents, notices, demands and any financial statements of whatsoever nature pursuant to this Agreement shall be in English language only.

If any provision of this Agreement is determined to be invalid, illegal or incapable of being enforced by any rule or law, or public policy, all other conditions and provisions of this Agreement shall nevertheless remain in full force and effect so long as the economic or legal substance of the transactions contemplated hereby is not affected in any manner materially adverse to either Party. Upon such determination that any term or other provision is invalid, illegal or incapable of being enforced, the Parties shall negotiate in good faith to amend this Agreement so as to effect the original intent of the Parties as closely as possible in a mutually acceptable manner.

Any delay or failure in the performance by either Party hereunder shall be excused if and to the extent caused by the occurrence of a Force Majeure. For purposes of this Agreement, Force Majeure shall mean an event beyond the reasonable control of a party (the "Affected Party") which does not relate to its fault or negligence or that of its employees, contractors, sub-contractors and suppliers. Force Majeure shall include acts of God, fires, floods, explosions, riots, wars, hurricane, sabotage terrorism, vandalism, accident, restraint of government, governmental acts, injunctions, labour strikes, other than those of the Affected Party despite such Party's reasonable efforts to prevent, avoid, delay, or mitigate the effect of such acts, events or occurrences, and which events or the effects thereof are not attributable to a Party's failure to perform its obligations under this Agreement. For avoidance of doubt, nothing in the Sub-Article 14.3 shall be deemed to mean that a Force Majeure event absolves either Party from any obligation to make payments for amounts due or becoming due hereunder in respect of matters arising prior to the occurrence of a Force Majeure event.

Each Party shall defend indemnify and hold harmless the other Party, including Affiliates and each of their respective officers, directors, shareholders, employees, representatives, agents, successors and assigns from and against all claims, including that of third parties, and all associated costs, to the extent arising out of (a) a Party's gross negligence or wilful misconduct in performing any of its obligations under this Agreement, or (b) a material breach by a Party of any of its representations, warranties, covenants or agreements under this Agreement.
This Agreement has been drawn up in two (2) originals, (1) to be retained by the Landlord, (1) by the Tenant.
